items.title: 4 IPOs set for market debut: Adroit eyes 40% listing pop; others flat start
items.description: Adroit Industries IPO GMP is ₹54, according to websites tracking the unofficial market. At the prevailing GMP, shares could list at ₹188, up 40 per cent from the IPO price of ₹134.

items.title: Anthropic's IPO filings: Massive losses, rising costs and more
items.description: Revenue grew 12-fold in 2025 to nearly $4.6 billion, even as the company lost more than $8 billion on an operating basis, excluding writedowns of various liabilities

items.title: Flipkart's uncertain IPO timeline leaves employee stock options tied up
items.description: Listing could be delayed by another one to two years as Walmart takes a wait-and-see approach; some former employees may seek clarity on the IPO timeline

items.title: Tata row: Maharashtra Charity Commissioner office may have a say
items.description: Maharashtra Charity Commissioner is examining whether Tata Trusts' actions breached norms as the Tata Sons board faces a governance dispute
